tools.name: fdic_bank_search
tools.description: Search FDIC-insured US banks by name, CERT number, state, city, 5-digit ZIP code, active/inactive status, or minimum assets (in $M). Returns CERT, active status, charter class, assets, deposits, ROA, ROE, domestic offices, and the official FDIC BankFind link.

tools.name: fdic_bank_health
tools.description: Detailed quarterly Call Report health and counterparty risk profile for one FDIC bank (by cert or name + optional state): total assets, deposits, estimated uninsured deposits %, core deposits %, Tier 1 leverage ratio, equity-to-assets, ROA, ROE, net interest margin, efficiency ratio, noncurrent loan

tools.name: fdic_bank_failures
tools.description: Official FDIC failed bank tracker from 1934 to today, sorted most recent first. Filter by start_year, end_year, state, or bank name. Returns failure date, CERT, location, assets and deposits at failure, estimated Deposit Insurance Fund (DIF) cost, and resolution type.

tools.name: fdic_bank_compare
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 FDIC-insured banks side by side using their latest Call Report financials: assets, deposits, estimated uninsured deposits %, Tier 1 leverage ratio, ROA, ROE, net interest margin, efficiency ratio, noncurrent loans %, and metric leaders.
